purpose: Test whether Stage A Hallmark network coordinates are materially attributable to bulk-sample tumor purity or leukocyte composition while preserving the Stage A metric definitions.
claim_ceiling: composition-adjusted static network map only; no causality, dynamics, damping, chi, transition, phase, or optimum claim

matching.source_filter: primary tumor sample type 01 only; ABSOLUTE additionally requires call status=called and finite purity
matching.primary_key: TCGA sample root through vial, e.g. TCGA-XX-YYYY-01A
matching.fallback: patient-level match only when the source contains exactly one eligible primary measurement for that patient
matching.duplicate_leukocyte_same_sample_root: median of finite replicate assay values before matching

models.eligible_cancers: all cancers with >=30 matched Stage A samples; Stage B0 yielded 32/32
all cancers with >=30 matched Stage A samples; Stage B0 yielded 30/32, excluding DLBC and THYM
all cancers with >=30 jointly matched Stage A samples; Stage B0 yielded 30/32, excluding DLBC and THYM

secondary_sensitivity.cibersort_relative: reserved for later secondary sensitivity only because it is RNA-derived and therefore not independent validation of an RNA network

fixed_n_design.sampling: deterministic without-replacement subsamples from the exact matched sample set for each cancer/model
fixed_n_design.paired_baseline: for every resample, compute unadjusted Stage A metrics on the exact same 30 patients used for context adjustment
fixed_n_design.reason: isolates context adjustment from cohort-size and coverage effects

residualization.scope: within cancer and within each n=30 resample
residualization.expression: Stage A log2p1 Hallmark expression cache; source missing expression remains missing
residualization.covariates: center and scale finite context covariates within the resample before OLS for numerical conditioning
residualization.single_covariate_model: gene expression = intercept + context covariate + residual
residualization.joint_model: gene expression = intercept + purity + leukocyte fraction + residual
residualization.per_gene_missingness: fit only finite expression cells; missing expression remains missing in the residual matrix
residualization.rank_deficiency: mark resample invalid rather than modify the model
residualization.network_metrics: unchanged Stage A Cin_pairwise, Cin_pc1, and Cout using the frozen Stage A missingness rules

construction_null.per_resample: one deterministic within-resample permutation of the context rows
construction_null.single_covariate: permute the covariate across the same 30 patients
construction_null.joint_model: permute the two-column purity/leukocyte context matrix jointly by row, preserving their internal correlation while breaking association to expression
construction_null.purpose: measure the generic change produced by fitting/residualization itself so it is not mistaken for context-specific network attenuation

module_level: context-specific paired delta = actual-adjusted minus permuted-null-adjusted
cancer_level: baseline-vs-adjusted module rank preservation for each metric
median module context-specific delta for each metric
Cin-vs-Cout and PC1-vs-Cout module-rank relationships before and after adjustment
